verdict.rationale: Hightouch's evidence describes a reverse-ETL/composable-CDP architecture: models are read FROM the warehouse and synced OUT to destinations (docs-2, docs-20, docs-27), and its only inbound 'ingestion' feature (Hightouch Events) explicitly covers only the customer's own instrumented websites/apps/backends via SDKs or HTTP API (docs-5, docs-6, docs-41) — the exact case the story excludes. There is no documented source connector for pulling data in from third-party cloud apps/feeds (e.g., Salesforce, Stripe, Zendesk) into the warehouse; 'sources' in the API refer to warehouses, not external SaaS ingestion.
